paragraphs: The Republic of Equatorial Guinea is a nation in west central Africa, and one of the smallest countries in Africa. It borders Cameroon on the north, Gabon on the south and east, and the Gulf of Guinea on the west. The country's territory is both on the continent and on islands. The continental part is known as Río Muni. The largest island is Bioko. The capital city is Ciudad de la Paz.
Equatorial Guinea and the peoples living there were colonized by Spain. Spanish is an official language because of this.
